issue.title: [google_cloud_rpc] Wire RetryRunner and per-call RequestOptions into ServiceClient for generated REST clients
issue.body_html:
Context & Problem

PR #352 extracts RetryRunner, ExponentialRetry, NoDelayRetry, and defaultIsRetryable into package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart (keep: list) so google_cloud_storage and google_cloud_pubsub (#353) can share a common retry implementation (#346).

However, three transport and codegen gaps remain before RetryRunner can reliably protect all 20+ generated REST client packages in generated/*:

  1. ServiceClient._makeRequest() Does Not Invoke RetryRunner or Accept RequestOptions:

    • ServiceClient._makeRequest() in generated/google_cloud_rpc/lib/service_client.dart still executes raw http.Client.send calls without invoking RetryRunner, and provides no mechanism for callers to configure client-level retry policies, per-call timeouts, or custom headers (RequestOptions).
    • By contrast, sibling sidekick-generated SDKs (google-cloud-rust and google-cloud-swift) wrap every generated client transport in a RetryLoop consulting a client-level RetryPolicy and per-call RequestOptions.

  2. Bug: ServiceException.fromHttpResponse Throws FormatException on HTML 502/503/504 Responses (Bypassing RetryRunner):

    • In generated/google_cloud_rpc/lib/src/exceptions.dart:60, ServiceException.fromHttpResponse(http.Response response, String body) calls JsonDecode(body) whenever body.isNotEmpty without catching FormatException.
    • When a Google Front End (GFE) or load balancer returns a transient 502 Bad Gateway, 503 Service Unavailable, or 504 Gateway Timeout with an HTML error page (<html>...), JsonDecode(body) throws an uncaught FormatException before ServiceException is constructed.
    • Because defaultIsRetryable in retry.dart (#352) checks if (error is ServiceException) (500, 502, 503, 504, 408, 429), an uncaught FormatException completely bypasses RetryRunner on gateway errors.
3. **AIP-4222 `x-goog-request-params` Routing Headers & AIP-155 Auto-Populated `request_id` UUIDv4 (`sidekick/dart`)**: - `sidekick/api` (`routing_info.go`) already parses `google.api.routing` annotations into `api.Method.Routing` and `auto_populated_fields` (`request_id` UUIDv4) into `api.Method.AutoPopulated`, and `sidekick/rust` emits both, whereas `sidekick/dart` currently drops them. - Emitting `x-goog-request-params` is required by [AIP-4222](https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4222) for regional/tenant routing, and auto-populating empty `request_id` fields with a UUIDv4 ([AIP-155](https://google.aip.dev/155) / [AIP-4235](https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4235)) makes mutating `POST` RPCs idempotent so `RetryRunner` can safely retry them on transient failures.

Proposed Solution

  1. Harden ServiceException.fromHttpResponse and Extend ServiceClient in package:google_cloud_rpc:
    • Wrap JsonDecode(body) in ServiceException.fromHttpResponse (exceptions.dart:60) in a try / on FormatException block that falls back to constructing the status-code-mapped ServiceException with response.reasonPhrase ?? body when the error payload is non-JSON/HTML.
    • Add an optional RetryRunner retry parameter to ServiceClient({...}) (defaulting to const NoDelayRetry() or per-service defaults passed by generated clients).
    • Add a RequestOptions class in package:google_cloud_rpc supporting per-call Duration? timeout, RetryRunner? retry, and Map<String, String>? headers.
    • Update ServiceClient._makeRequest() to execute requests through (options?.retry ?? this.retry).run(...) with optional timeout enforcement.
  2. Update sidekick/dart Generator Templates (googleapis/librarian):
    • Pass service-specific retry defaults (from service config / librarian.yaml) when constructing ServiceClient.
    • Add an optional RequestOptions? options parameter to generated RPC methods in method.mustache.
    • Emit x-goog-request-params headers from api.Method.Routing (AIP-4222) and auto-populate unset request_id fields (api.Method.AutoPopulated) with a UUIDv4 before entering RetryRunner.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ServiceException.fromHttpResponse gracefully handles non-JSON/HTML 502/503/504 error bodies without throwing FormatException, allowing RetryRunner to retry gateway errors.
  • ServiceClient in package:google_cloud_rpc supports RetryRunner and per-request RequestOptions.
  • Generated REST clients in generated/* support configurable retry policies, per-call RequestOptions, x-goog-request-params routing headers, and auto-populated request_id UUIDs.

issue.body:
### Context & Problem

PR #352 extracts `RetryRunner`, `ExponentialRetry`, `NoDelayRetry`, and `defaultIsRetryable` into `package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart` (`keep:` list) so `google_cloud_storage` and `google_cloud_pubsub` (#353) can share a common retry implementation (#346).

However, three transport and codegen gaps remain before `RetryRunner` can reliably protect all 20+ generated REST client packages in `generated/*`:

1. **`ServiceClient._makeRequest()` Does Not Invoke `RetryRunner` or Accept `RequestOptions`**:
   - `ServiceClient._makeRequest()` in `generated/google_cloud_rpc/lib/service_client.dart` still executes raw `http.Client.send` calls without invoking `RetryRunner`, and provides no mechanism for callers to configure client-level retry policies, per-call timeouts, or custom headers (`RequestOptions`).
   - By contrast, sibling `sidekick`-generated SDKs (`google-cloud-rust` and `google-cloud-swift`) wrap every generated client transport in a `RetryLoop` consulting a client-level `RetryPolicy` and per-call `RequestOptions`.

2. **Bug: `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse` Throws `FormatException` on HTML `502`/`503`/`504` Responses (Bypassing `RetryRunner`)**:
   - In `generated/google_cloud_rpc/lib/src/exceptions.dart:60`, `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse(http.Response response, String body)` calls `JsonDecode(body)` whenever `body.isNotEmpty` without catching `FormatException`.
   - When a Google Front End (GFE) or load balancer returns a transient `502 Bad Gateway`, `503 Service Unavailable`, or `504 Gateway Timeout` with an HTML error page (`<html>...`), `JsonDecode(body)` throws an uncaught `FormatException` **before `ServiceException` is constructed**.
   - Because `defaultIsRetryable` in `retry.dart` (#352) checks `if (error is ServiceException)` (`500`, `502`, `503`, `504`, `408`, `429`), an uncaught `FormatException` completely bypasses `RetryRunner` on gateway errors.

<del>
3. **AIP-4222 `x-goog-request-params` Routing Headers & AIP-155 Auto-Populated `request_id` UUIDv4 (`sidekick/dart`)**:
   - `sidekick/api` (`routing_info.go`) already parses `google.api.routing` annotations into `api.Method.Routing` and `auto_populated_fields` (`request_id` UUIDv4) into `api.Method.AutoPopulated`, and `sidekick/rust` emits both, whereas `sidekick/dart` currently drops them.
   - Emitting `x-goog-request-params` is required by [AIP-4222](https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4222) for regional/tenant routing, and auto-populating empty `request_id` fields with a UUIDv4 ([AIP-155](https://google.aip.dev/155) / [AIP-4235](https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4235)) makes mutating `POST` RPCs idempotent so `RetryRunner` can safely retry them on transient failures.
</del>

### Proposed Solution

1. **Harden `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse` and Extend `ServiceClient` in `package:google_cloud_rpc`**:
   - Wrap `JsonDecode(body)` in `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse` (`exceptions.dart:60`) in a `try / on FormatException` block that falls back to constructing the status-code-mapped `ServiceException` with `response.reasonPhrase ?? body` when the error payload is non-JSON/HTML.
   - Add an optional `RetryRunner retry` parameter to `ServiceClient({...})` (defaulting to `const NoDelayRetry()` or per-service defaults passed by generated clients).
   - Add a `RequestOptions` class in `package:google_cloud_rpc` supporting per-call `Duration? timeout`, `RetryRunner? retry`, and `Map<String, String>? headers`.
   - Update `ServiceClient._makeRequest()` to execute requests through `(options?.retry ?? this.retry).run(...)` with optional timeout enforcement.
2. **Update `sidekick/dart` Generator Templates (`googleapis/librarian`)**:
   - Pass service-specific retry defaults (from service config / `librarian.yaml`) when constructing `ServiceClient`.
   - Add an optional `RequestOptions? options` parameter to generated RPC methods in `method.mustache`.
   - Emit `x-goog-request-params` headers from `api.Method.Routing` ([AIP-4222](https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4222)) and auto-populate unset `request_id` fields (`api.Method.AutoPopulated`) with a UUIDv4 before entering `RetryRunner`.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse` gracefully handles non-JSON/HTML `502`/`503`/`504` error bodies without throwing `FormatException`, allowing `RetryRunner` to retry gateway errors.
- [ ] `ServiceClient` in `package:google_cloud_rpc` supports `RetryRunner` and per-request `RequestOptions`.
- [ ] Generated REST clients in `generated/*` support configurable retry policies, per-call `RequestOptions`, `x-goog-request-params` routing headers, and auto-populated `request_id` UUIDs.

comments.body_html:
Retry examples:

Go:

package main

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	secretmanager "cloud.google.com/go/secretmanager/apiv1"
	"cloud.google.com/go/secretmanager/apiv1/secretmanagerpb"
	"github.com/googleapis/gax-go/v2"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
)

func example(ctx context.Context) error {
	client, err := secretmanager.NewClient(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer client.Close()

	// 1. Client-level (per-method) override on CallOptions:
	client.CallOptions.GetSecret = []gax.CallOption{
		gax.WithRetry(func() gax.Retryer {
			return gax.OnCodes([]codes.Code{
				codes.Unavailable,
				codes.DeadlineExceeded,
			}, gax.Backoff{
				Initial:    100 * time.Millisecond,
				Max:        10 * time.Second,
				Multiplier: 1.3,
			})
		}),
	}

	// 2. Per-call override via variadic gax.CallOption:
	req := &secretmanagerpb.GetSecretRequest{Name: "projects/my-project/secrets/my-secret"}
	secret, err := client.GetSecret(
		ctx,
		req,
		gax.WithTimeout(30*time.Second),
		gax.WithRetry(func() gax.Retryer {
			// Return a fresh Retryer per call (Retryer is stateful)
			return gax.OnHTTPCodes(gax.Backoff{
				Initial:    500 * time.Millisecond,
				Max:        30 * time.Second,
				Multiplier: 2.0,
			}, 429, 502, 503, 504)
		}),
	)
	_ = secret
	return err
}

Java:

import com.google.api.gax.httpjson.HttpJsonCallContext;
import com.google.api.gax.retrying.RetrySettings;
import com.google.api.gax.rpc.StatusCode;
import com.google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.GetSecretRequest;
import com.google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.Secret;
import com.google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretManagerServiceClient;
import com.google.cloud.secretmanager.v1.SecretManagerServiceSettings;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Set;

public class RetryExample {
  public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
    // 1. Client-level (per-method) configuration via Settings Builder:
    SecretManagerServiceSettings.Builder settingsBuilder =
        SecretManagerServiceSettings.newHttpJsonBuilder();

    settingsBuilder
        .getSecretSettings()
        .setRetryableCodes(
            StatusCode.Code.UNAVAILABLE,
            StatusCode.Code.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED)
        .setRetrySettings(
            RetrySettings.newBuilder()
                .setInitialRetryDelayDuration(Duration.ofMillis(100))
                .setRetryDelayMultiplier(1.3)
                .setMaxRetryDelayDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(60))
                .setInitialRpcTimeoutDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .setMaxRpcTimeoutDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .setTotalTimeoutDuration(Duration.ofMinutes(5))
                .setMaxAttempts(5)
                .build());

    try (SecretManagerServiceClient client =
        SecretManagerServiceClient.create(settingsBuilder.build())) {

      GetSecretRequest request =
          GetSecretRequest.newBuilder()
              .setName("projects/my-project/secrets/my-secret")
              .build();

      // 2. Per-call override using the generated Callable + ApiCallContext:
      HttpJsonCallContext callContext =
          HttpJsonCallContext.createDefault()
              .withRetrySettings(
                  RetrySettings.newBuilder()
                      .setMaxAttempts(3)
                      .setInitialRetryDelayDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(1))
                      .build())
              .withRetryableCodes(Set.of(StatusCode.Code.UNAVAILABLE))
              .withTimeoutDuration(Duration.ofSeconds(15));

      Secret secret = client.getSecretCallable().call(request, callContext);
    }
  }
}

Python:

from google.api_core import exceptions
from google.api_core import retry
from google.cloud import secretmanager_v1

# Initialize the client (using REST transport if desired)
client = secretmanager_v1.SecretManagerServiceClient(transport="rest")

# Define a custom retry policy
custom_retry = retry.Retry(
    predicate=retry.if_exception_type(
        exceptions.ServiceUnavailable,
        exceptions.DeadlineExceeded,
        exceptions.InternalServerError,
    ),
    initial=1.0,       # 1s initial delay
    maximum=60.0,      # 60s max delay
    multiplier=2.0,    # exponential multiplier
    timeout=120.0,     # total retry deadline (2 minutes)
)

request = secretmanager_v1.GetSecretRequest(
    name="projects/my-project/secrets/my-secret"
)

# Pass retry, timeout, and metadata per-call
response = client.get_secret(
    request=request,
    retry=custom_retry,
    timeout=30.0,
    metadata=[("x-custom-header", "value")],
)
I think that the client side changes required for AIP-4222 & AIP-155 are covered by #80 so I'm going to remove that part of this bug.

issue.title: feat(google_cloud_rpc): extract shared RetryRunner and ExponentialRetry
issue.body_html:
Moves the retry support from package:google_cloud_storage into
package:google_cloud_rpc so that other packages (starting with
package:google_cloud_pubsub) can share it.

  • RetryRunner, ExponentialRetry, NoDelayRetry, defaultRetry, and
    delaySequence move to package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart, and
    ChecksumValidationException moves to
    package:google_cloud_rpc/exceptions.dart.
    package:google_cloud_storage still exports everything it exported
    before, so existing imports keep working.
  • ExponentialRetry gains an optional jitter that randomizes each
    delay, and value equality. RetryRunner gains isRetryable (which
    also recognizes gRPC status codes) and delays, and RetryRunner.run
    takes an optional clock.
  • retry_test.dart moves along with the code.
  • google_cloud_rpc is a generated package, so librarian.yaml now
    keeps the new hand-written files and lists the new clock and meta
    dependencies.
  • google_cloud_storage is bumped to 0.6.5-wip. Before it is published,
    it will need to require the next google_cloud_rpc release (#366).

Split out from #292 (1/4).
Closes #346

issue.body:
Moves the retry support from `package:google_cloud_storage` into
`package:google_cloud_rpc` so that other packages (starting with
`package:google_cloud_pubsub`) can share it.

* `RetryRunner`, `ExponentialRetry`, `NoDelayRetry`, `defaultRetry`, and
  `delaySequence` move to `package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart`, and
  `ChecksumValidationException` moves to
  `package:google_cloud_rpc/exceptions.dart`.
  `package:google_cloud_storage` still exports everything it exported
  before, so existing imports keep working.
* `ExponentialRetry` gains an optional `jitter` that randomizes each
  delay, and value equality. `RetryRunner` gains `isRetryable` (which
  also recognizes gRPC status codes) and `delays`, and `RetryRunner.run`
  takes an optional `clock`.
* `retry_test.dart` moves along with the code.
* `google_cloud_rpc` is a generated package, so `librarian.yaml` now
  keeps the new hand-written files and lists the new `clock` and `meta`
  dependencies.
* `google_cloud_storage` is bumped to 0.6.5-wip. Before it is published,
  it will need to require the next `google_cloud_rpc` release (#366).

Split out from #292 (1/4).
Closes #346

pull.body:
Moves the retry support from `package:google_cloud_storage` into
`package:google_cloud_rpc` so that other packages (starting with
`package:google_cloud_pubsub`) can share it.

* `RetryRunner`, `ExponentialRetry`, `NoDelayRetry`, `defaultRetry`, and
  `delaySequence` move to `package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart`, and
  `ChecksumValidationException` moves to
  `package:google_cloud_rpc/exceptions.dart`.
  `package:google_cloud_storage` still exports everything it exported
  before, so existing imports keep working.
* `ExponentialRetry` gains an optional `jitter` that randomizes each
  delay, and value equality. `RetryRunner` gains `isRetryable` (which
  also recognizes gRPC status codes) and `delays`, and `RetryRunner.run`
  takes an optional `clock`.
* `retry_test.dart` moves along with the code.
* `google_cloud_rpc` is a generated package, so `librarian.yaml` now
  keeps the new hand-written files and lists the new `clock` and `meta`
  dependencies.
* `google_cloud_storage` is bumped to 0.6.5-wip. Before it is published,
  it will need to require the next `google_cloud_rpc` release (#366).

Split out from #292 (1/4).
Closes #346

issue.title: feat(google_cloud_pubsub): add Pub/Sub retry configuration and gRPC error mapping
issue.body_html:
Adds the defaultRetry configuration (ExponentialRetry with 100ms
initial delay, 1.3x multiplier, 60s maximum delay, 1m maximum
retry interval, and ±20% jitter), re-exports RetryRunner,
ExponentialRetry, and NoDelayRetry from package:google_cloud_rpc,
and populates ServiceException.status in PubSub._mapGrpcError.

package:google_cloud_rpc models exceptions by HTTP status code
(ConflictException for 409, InternalServerErrorException for 500,
etc.) and includes an optional ServiceException.status field holding
the underlying google.rpc.Status (code, message, details). While
REST clients populate status in ServiceException.fromHttpResponse,
PubSub._mapGrpcError previously left status as null when
converting gRPC GrpcErrors into ServiceExceptions.

Because gRPC has more granular status codes than HTTP
(google/rpc/code.proto), multiple gRPC codes with opposite retry
behavior in Pub/Sub
collapse into the same HTTP exception class:

  • ConflictException (HTTP 409): used for both ALREADY_EXISTS
    (code 6, non-retryable) and ABORTED (code 10, retryable).
  • InternalServerErrorException (HTTP 500): used for INTERNAL
    (code 13, retryable), UNKNOWN (code 2, retryable), and
    DATA_LOSS (code 15, non-retryable).

Populating ServiceException.status with
Status(code: e.code, message: message) in _mapGrpcError preserves
the original gRPC status code so ExponentialRetry.isRetryable (and
callers) can distinguish these cases.

Split out from #292 (2/4).

issue.title: Share retry logic between google_cloud_pubsub and google_cloud_storage (before pubsub 1.0)
issue.body_html:
google_cloud_pubsub and google_cloud_storage each have their own retry
implementation, and the ServiceException half of the retryability predicate
(408/429/500/502/503/504) is currently duplicated verbatim between them.

  • pkgs/google_cloud_pubsub/lib/src/retry.dart — RetrySettings data class
    (validated, non-const, ==/hashCode), plus @internal delaySequence,
    isRetryable, runWithRetry. Only RetrySettings is exported.
  • pkgs/google_cloud_storage/lib/src/retry.dart — sealed RetryRunner /
    ExponentialRetry / NoDelayRetry / const defaultRetry, exported
    wholesale and threaded through ~39 public signatures.

Context: #292

Suggested order

  1. Share the internals first (delaySequence, runWithRetry, and the
    ServiceException arm of the predicate). This is invisible to users and
    needs no public API decision.
  2. Only then consider unifying the public settings type.

Open questions to resolve first

  • Home package. package:google_cloud_rpc is the only package both
    already depend on (^0.6.0), but it is generated: lib/rpc.dart is not in
    librarian's keep list, so hand-written lib/retry.dart +
    lib/src/retry.dart + tests must each be added to keep, and clock added
    to its dependencies — which makes clock transitive for every generated
    REST package. It must also stay free of package:grpc.
  • const vs validation. defaultRetry is a const default parameter
    value in ~39 storage signatures, so a merged type must have a const
    constructor — which cannot have a body. But asserts cannot express the
    Duration invariants at all (assert(initialDelay > Duration.zero) in a
    const constructor is a compile error: "In constant expressions, operands of
    this operator must be of type 'num'"    ), and the int/double asserts that
    can be written do not run under dart run or dart compile exe. So
    unifying the type means losing eager ArgumentError validation unless a
    separate checkValid() is introduced and called from every non-const
    boundary.
  • NoDelayRetry. It is const ... (initialDelay: Duration.zero, maxDelay: Duration.zero), which pubsub's validation explicitly rejects.
  • Jitter. pubsub applies ±20%; storage applies none. Unifying changes
    storage's runtime retry timing.
  • Defaults must stay per-service. pubsub 100 ms / ×1.3 / 1 min vs storage
    1 s / ×2 / 2 min. Do not share defaultRetry.
  • Naming. pubsub's totalTimeout matches GAX; storage's
    maxRetryInterval reads like a per-attempt cap, which is actually
    maxDelay.

Constraint

Move the declaration and re-export it — never introduce a second same-named
type. Two RetrySettings declarations would be an ambiguous import for anyone
using both packages.

Until this is done, any fix to retryability must be applied to both copies.

`google_cloud_pubsub` and `google_cloud_storage` each have their own retry
implementation, and the `ServiceException` half of the retryability predicate
(408/429/500/502/503/504) is currently duplicated verbatim between them.

- `pkgs/google_cloud_pubsub/lib/src/retry.dart` — `RetrySettings` data class
  (validated, non-const, `==`/`hashCode`), plus `@internal` `delaySequence`,

- `pkgs/google_cloud_storage/lib/src/retry.dart` — `sealed RetryRunner` /

  wholesale and threaded through ~39 public signatures.

Context: https://github.com/googleapis/google-cloud-dart/pull/292

1. Share the **internals** first (`delaySequence`, `runWithRetry`, and the

   needs no public API decision.
2. Only then consider unifying the public settings type.

## Open questions to resolve first

- **Home package.** `package:google_cloud_rpc` is the only package both
  already depend on (`^0.6.0`), but it is generated: `lib/rpc.dart` is not in
  librarian's `keep` list, so hand-written `lib/retry.dart` +
  `lib/src/retry.dart` + tests must each be added to `keep`, and `clock` added
  to its dependencies — which makes `clock` transitive for every generated
  REST package. It must also stay free of `package:grpc`.
- **`const` vs validation.** `defaultRetry` is a `const` default parameter
  value in ~39 storage signatures, so a merged type must have a `const`
  constructor — which cannot have a body. But `assert`s cannot express the
  `Duration` invariants at all (`assert(initialDelay > Duration.zero)` in a
  const constructor is a compile error: *"In constant expressions, operands of
  this operator must be of type 'num'"*), and the `int`/`double` asserts that
  *can* be written do not run under `dart run` or `dart compile exe`. So
  unifying the type means losing eager `ArgumentError` validation unless a
  separate `checkValid()` is introduced and called from every non-const
  boundary.
- **`NoDelayRetry`.** It is `const ... (initialDelay: Duration.zero,
  maxDelay: Duration.zero)`, which pubsub's validation explicitly rejects.
- **Jitter.** pubsub applies ±20%; storage applies none. Unifying changes
  storage's runtime retry timing.
- **Defaults must stay per-service.** pubsub 100 ms / ×1.3 / 1 min vs storage
  1 s / ×2 / 2 min. Do not share `defaultRetry`.
- **Naming.** pubsub's `totalTimeout` matches GAX; storage's
  `maxRetryInterval` reads like a per-attempt cap, which is actually
  `maxDelay`.

Move the declaration and re-export it — never introduce a second same-named
type. Two `RetrySettings` declarations would be an ambiguous import for anyone
